name: yanshu-workbench
description: Extensible research workflows coordinated across local files and visible ChatGPT sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Installable research workflows for writing, figures, and publication.
interface.longDescription: YanShu is an extensible research-workflow plugin. Its first workflow, Paper Reconstruction, delegates manuscript writing and figure generation to the user's visible ChatGPT Chat session while a controlled local MCP workspace provides approved TeX, BibTeX, PDF-page and figure evidence, versioned outputs, compilation, fallbacks, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use YanShu to start the Paper Reconstruction workflow for this manuscript directory.
Use YanShu to inspect whether this paper directory has the TeX, PDF, BibTeX, and figure inputs required by Paper Reconstruction.
Use YanShu to resume the interrupted Paper Reconstruction run in this paper directory.
